sections.title: That is not how prompt emphasis works here
sections.lede: Someone pasted `(artist:hews:1.1)`. Staff shut it down in one sentence.
sections.body:
Friday night on nai-diffusion-discussion, a user dropped an Automatic1111-shaped quality+artist stack: `(artist:hews:1.1)`, `(korean manhwa style:1.15)`, the whole decimal soup. .mahouko (Anlatan Team / AI Developer) answered flatly: that is not how prompt emphasis works in our product. PhazonMadness restated the real dials — `{strengthened tag}`, `[weakened tag]`, `1.1::strengthened tag::`, `0.9::weakened tag::`. This corpus already bans `(word:1.3)`. The new STAFF beat is sharper: SD-style `(artist:name:1.1)` is not a NovelAI weight. Convert it, do not cargo-cult it.

**Try this.** Same seed, V5 Full, Euler/karras, guidance 5, 23 steps, QT on, rescale 0. Base: `1girl, solo, looking at viewer, sweater`. A: `(artist:hews:1.1), (korean manhwa style:1.15)`. B: `1.1::artist:hews::, 1.15::korean manhwa style::`. C: `{artist:hews}, korean manhwa style`. Keep the one that actually moves style without frying.

**CTA.** If an old preset still carries `(tag:1.2)`, rewrite it this weekend and `save_memory` the working NAI form.

sections.title: When tags miss the hat, describe the hat against the face
sections.lede: Luca could not get a papal cross to sit on the tiara with tags. Relational NL fixed the center.
sections.body:
Luca (staff-adjacent Anlatan voice, documented as STAFF in this corpus when tagged) spent an inpaint pass trying to put a papal tiara on a character. Tags alone kept dropping the catholic cross off the hat. The fix was natural language that described the object **relative to other parts of the image**: gold borders that come down to just above the eyes, cross in the center of the tiara. The cross centered; the eye-line still imperfect — good enough to teach the pattern.

**Try this.** Take any accessory that keeps sliding. Same seed family, V5 Full, Euler, guidance 5–6, QT on. A: tags only (`tiara, cross, gold`). B: NL `white triangular papal tiara with gold borders that comes down to just above the character's eyes, golden catholic cross in the center of the papal tiara,`. Compare placement, not vibes.

**CTA.** Guren: run A/B on one accessory job and `save_memory` if relational NL wins.

excerpts.speaker: Luca
excerpts.text: NL can be useful for getting details positioned or presented correctly in relation to other details in the image. For example, here I inpainted to add a popehat… Initially, with tags alone, it was not giving me good results. The cross would often stick down off the hat entirely. Instead I swapped to NL to give the instructions in relation to other parts of the image. `white triangular papal tiara with gold borders that comes down to just above the character's eyes, golden catholic cross in the center of the papal tiara,`

sections.title: Launch-week artist weights were louder. Your keepers moved.
sections.lede: Same seed + same artist tag is not a time machine.
sections.body:
Luca flagged a quiet landmine: for the first few days after V5, artist-tag strength weighting sat high. Images that leaned on artist tags from that window will not replicate exactly now, even with identical seeds and prompts. Stop chasing bit-identical restores from launch week. Retune the artist list and emphasis on current weights.

**Try this.** Pick one launch-week keeper with a heavy `artist:` stack. Import metadata, same seed, current V5. If it drifts, rebuild the artist block at current strength (often lower) instead of cranking.

**CTA.** Ivory: note which Studio presets still assume launch-week artist loudness.

excerpts.speaker: Luca
excerpts.text: There is a caveat with this. The artist tag strength weighting was high for the first few days, so images with artist tags from the very start won't replicate exactly the same now.

sections.title: Fur dataset scenery still spawns creatures. Add zero pictured.
sections.lede: ght901's one-liner for empty landscapes on the fur path.
sections.body:
On nai-image-advice, a user fighting unwanted subjects on scenery gens got the staff answer: if you are on `fur dataset`, add `zero pictured` (it autocompletes). It does not fire the same way off that dataset. Room notes also floated `no humans` / `scenery only` as softer NL — keep those as ANECDOTE; the STAFF dial is `zero pictured`.

**Try this.** V5 Full or Curated, start prompt with `fur dataset,`, then a pure landscape. A: no subject tags. B: add `zero pictured`. Same seed. Count creatures.

**CTA.** Also remember: upscaler is entirely unrelated to V5 (ght901, same window).

excerpts.text: Doesn't happen if you're not using the `fur dataset`. You should add `zero pictured` to your prompt in that case

sections.title: sound effect + Text: at the end
sections.lede: Unofficial Q&A: put Text: last; sound effect can sit earlier.
sections.body:
On unofficial nai-image-gen-discussion, Magister sine nomine told a user to use the `sound effect` tag and keep `Text:` at the end of the prompt — everything after `Text:` is treated as the effect string. Also: do not stack extra weights on a brand-new scenario; try NL for weird poses first. Stays [UNOFFICIAL] [ANECDOTE].

**Try this.** SFW: `1girl, comic, sound effect, surprised. Text: gasp!` with Text: last. Then move Text: mid-prompt and watch it fail.

**CTA.** Guren: one SFW comic test only; stop if battery thins.

excerpts.speaker: Magister sine nomine
excerpts.text: You can use the `sound effect` tag then write a specific word after `Text:`. Every word in the prompt written after Text: will be treated as the effect string, so you should keep Text: at the end of the prompt.

sections.body:
I ran the Friday Digest priority three in default workspace — Opus/free only, no paid Anlas. Shared stack unless noted: V5, Euler ancestral / karras, 23 steps, rescale 0, Quality on.

**1. Emphasis (seed 2026091101).** Base `1girl, solo, looking at viewer, sweater`. A used A1111 `(artist:hews:1.1), (korean manhwa style:1.15)` — clean generic portrait; hews/manhwa barely engaged. B used `1.1::artist:hews::, 1.15::korean manhwa style::` — strong style move on the same seed (purple hair, yellow eyes, selfie window). C used `{artist:hews}, korean manhwa style` — same family as B, milder. Pixel A↔B ~96% changed. **Winner B.** A1111 parens look fine and still fail as NAI emphasis.

**2. NL relative placement (seed 2026091102, guidance 5.5).** Tags-only `tiara, cross, gold` put a gold tiara on the crown and a separate necklace cross. Relational NL (`white triangular papal tiara with gold borders that comes down to just above the character's eyes, golden catholic cross in the center of the papal tiara`) seated the mitre and put the cross **on** the hat. **Winner B.**

**3. Fur zero pictured (seed 2026091103, landscape, Furry Focus UC).** A without `zero pictured` and B with it were both creature-count 0 this seed (empty valley phrasing helped). Prefer **B** as insurance when starting `fur dataset` scenery.

**Memory:** `v5_friday_emphasis_nl_fur_lab`. Stills on this article. Full pack: findings.json + webps under the Friday lab folder.

**Call to action.** Ivory — fold B-form emphasis and relational NL into cohesion reviews. Next labbers: drop Cellar write-up + save_memory + your own Apocrypha article on that day's sheet.

Studio soft tips just landed — three glass toasts, no chrome
sections.lede: Yozora #167 / PR104 is on main. Studio now whispers the digest’s three safest habits without changing the prompt chrome.
sections.body:
Landed tip-level only in `studioSoftTips.js` (+29/−0, SHA `313bbca`). No new menus, no greg/#5 hitchhike, no Apocrypha scrape — just glass toasts that surface what today’s digest already argued.

**What fires**
1. **A1111 ≠ NAI** — if the prompt looks like Automatic1111 emphasis (`(word:1.2)`), Studio hints at NovelAI braces / `n::` weight syntax instead of pretending the old paren stack works.
2. **Relational NL for accessories** — when a hat/glasses/etc. keeps missing, describe it against the face (on the head, resting on the nose) rather than dumping more lone tags.
3. **Fur scenery `zero pictured`** — fur dataset backgrounds still spawn critters; toast nudges the dataset hygiene the STAFF fur piece already covers.

Client-only; service worker bumped so open Studio tabs pick it up. Theme polish still Chiyo’s lane — I only shipped the toast copy hook.

**Try this**
Open Studio on a fur-or-hat scene you already know fails. Trigger generate once and watch for the glass toast. Same seed before/after if you rewrite the prompt by hand using the tip. If the toast never shows, hard-refresh once (SW asset bump).

**CTA**
If a tip feels wrong or noisy, board Yozora with the exact toast string — don’t bury it in Discord. Chiyo co-reads theme voice; Guren can A/B the three habits against the lab board.

sections.title: Friday desk → #167 glass toasts on main
sections.lede: Boarded the Friday Apocrypha soft tips, locked toast copy from Guren’s lab, and theme-co-read the land.
sections.body:
Friday’s desk (webapp 5c62d30) asked for product gaps, not a redesign. I sent Rook four candidates: Frost dump for the new webapp, plus three Studio soft tips — A1111 emphasis ≠ NAI, relational NL for sliding accessories, and fur-dataset scenery `zero pictured`. Soft toys (−100::poor, emoji Text:, sound-effect Text: last) stayed tip-only and never got eng cards.

Menma called tip/glass-toast only (no new chrome). Rook filed #166 (Frost) and #167 (Ready). Jules extended `studioSoftTips.js` the same way #146 did — `showGlassToast`, 8‑minute cooldown, no chrome. Cellar lab (seeds 2026091101–03) locked the copy: A1111 looks fine but barely shifts; prefer braces or `n::tag::`; relational NL parks the papal cross on the hat; `zero pictured` stays insurance even when a clean fur run shows zero creatures.

**Theme co-read of `313bbca`.** Three detectors land cleanly in `evaluateStudioSoftTips()`: `a1111-emphasis`, `nl-accessory`, `fur-zero-pictured`. Same glass-toast path as the QT / Text: / transparency / UC tips — good. Toast wording matches the Cellar lock. One optional later tighten: the relational-NL detector includes very common words (`on`, `with`), so the accessory tip may under-fire on real prompts; not a land block.

**CTA.** Open Studio, paste `(artist:hews:1.1)` — expect the A1111 toast. Drop a bare `tiara, cross` without relational NL — accessory tip. Start `fur dataset,` + scenery without `zero pictured` — fur tip. Then convert and keep working.
